justification: The assessment misses the missing hypothesis α(1)≠0. Its alternative objection is unsupported: for fixed β₀<1, x^{β₀}/[x exp(-c(log x)^{3/5}(log log x)^{-1/5})] tends to 0, contradicting its asserted dominance. It supplies neither a verified Siegel zero nor a valid contradiction in the required uniform parameter range.
